name: goexpressly-frontend
description: GoExpressly public tracking and admin UI

scripts.build:js: npx terser src/js/theme.js -o dist/js/theme.min.js && npx terser src/js/carousel.js -o dist/js/carousel.min.js && npx terser src/js/api.js -o dist/js/api.min.js && npx terser src/js/track.js -o dist/js/track.min.js && npx terser src/js/auth.js -o dist/js/auth.min.js && npx terser src/js/dashboard.js -o dist/js/dashboard.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
